LESSON: VOLUME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Volume

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volume, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How is Volume applicable in real life?
